messages:
sana (PM): Quick thread to lock the GA acceptance bullets for tomorrow7s roadmap review. Need agreement on SLA metrics, minimum docs, support rotation, monitoring minima, and how we label pricing.
jay (Eng): Runtime update: if we fix batching=legacy and enable KV cache by default, expected p50~110ms p95~340ms for typical routes. We need to call out the default batch-window in the public config.
dara (SRE): For SLAs I propose: availability objective = 99.9% measured monthly, outage definition = sustained 5xx >0.5% for 10m OR stream timeouts. Also recommend an error budget calc example in the SLA doc.
matt (Docs): Docs gating: public quickstart + troubleshooting FAQ required for GA. Internal runbook and full runbook can follow within 14 days. Public FAQ should include an auth example, throttling troubleshooting, and 2 token-cost worked examples.
hana (FinOps): Pricing note: mark self-serve pricing as "indicative" for GA. If we promise committed tiers publicly, we must finish billing E2E tests and quoting flows first (2 business days). Recommend "preview" label.
legal-bot: legal: include credit-only remedies capped to affected-month invoice; require 30-day notice for breaking API changes in contract; include force majeure. Need exact outage wording for final sign-off.
sana (PM): Proposal to lock: SLA p95 target per-route = 400ms, availability obj = 99.9% monthly, remedies = billing credits capped. Docs = quickstart + FAQ at GA; internal runbook in 14d. Support = SRE primary for GA week, product pager for initial 2hr triage. Monitoring = p50/p95, token-cost per-model, per-route error-rate, alerts for (1) p95 spike, (2) error-rate>1% 10m, (3) cache-hit drop>20%. Pricing = indicative self-serve, committed via sales.
jay (Eng): +1, will put the batch-window config + default cache flags in the config PR today.
dara (SRE): +1 but will post the precise outage measurement wording and an example error-budget calculation for legal review by EOD. Also request synthetic checks from 3 regions at 1m cadence.
matt (Docs): +1; FAQ template up in a few hours. I7ll include the token-cost calc snippet: `cost = tokens * model_rate` and a short worked example.
hana (FinOps): +1 on indicative pricing; I7ll run billing test plan Wed-Thu and report.
sana (PM): Thanks. Action items: Jay PR (batching/config), Dara SLA wording + error budget, Matt FAQ + quickstart, Hana billing tests. If we see canary alarms, call it out here and we7ll pause rollout. :rocket:
